values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753414 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a dock, a fishing pier/platform, a concrete boat ramp, 'Sheltered', a toilet and primitive campsites.

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on Dailey Lake with designated primitive camping (Region 3). No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping (with/without fishing license), dock, fishing pier, concrete ramp, toilet, primitive campsites; open-all-year season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: directions, size, site count, trailer length, stay limit, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of the empty directions line and the restated facilities, FCFS and fee text.
